turns.text: Hello. I would like to return a catalogue print. It does not suit the wall.
Hello, and I am sorry the print does not suit your wall. I can help with a return. Please send me your order number (it looks like SC-1234) and the email the order was placed with.
The order is SC-5211 and the email is ysolde.macinca@example.com. It arrived within the last two weeks.

Thank you, Ysolde. Your return request for order SC-5211 (Păunul de ceață, 40x50 cm) is filed as R-1 and is waiting for staff approval. Under our policy, catalogue prints can be returned within 14 days of delivery, and the customer pays the return postage. Staff must approve the refund, so I cannot confirm it yet. Is there anything else I can help you with?

rule.ro: Printurile din catalog se pot returna în 14 zile de la livrare. Clientul plătește transportul retur. Rambursarea trebuie aprobată de echipă.
rule.en: Catalogue prints can be returned within 14 days of delivery. The customer pays the return postage. Staff must approve the refund.
